signal: Sustainment runs an AI-based domestic manufacturing network connecting 50,000+ executives across 20,000 companies, serving both DoD and commercial procurement teams

email.body1:
Spencer, saw Sustainment connecting 50,000-plus manufacturing leaders across 20,000 companies, spanning DoD and commercial procurement.

A network that large produces more buying signals than the team can act on, and the latency between a signal firing and a rep touching it is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sustainment off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Spencer, quick follow-up for Sustainment.

Wearing both marketing and RevOps, you feel the gap firsthand: signals fire, but data hygiene and manual research mean reps act days later, and the measurable lift never shows. Closing the signal-to-touch gap is where the numbers move.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Spencer, last bit of proof for Sustainment.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sustainment's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Spencer, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and owning both marketing and RevOps keeps the calendar full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I'll tailor it to Sustainment either way.
